text: Code reviews are an important part of software development. When developers review each other's code before it is merged, they can catch bugs early, which saves time and money later. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing, because team members learn how others solve problems and discover parts of the codebase they did not know. In addition, regular reviews improve team quality by keeping the code consistent and easy to maintain. Although reviews take extra time, they are worth the effort. In short, code reviews help teams write better software and work together more effectively.
